layerwise_probe.caption: Validation AUROC per layer for mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, 5 seeds. Layer selection used the validation partition only; the frozen selection was evaluated once on test. Shaded band is +/-1 SD across seeds. Dataset data/derived/poker_bluff_judge_question_v1.csv.

learning_curve.caption: Test AUROC as a function of training-set size for mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3. Subsampling is at group (hand) level with 5 independent draws per size, so a smaller training set is fewer hands rather than fewer rows from the same hands. Error bars are +/-1 SD across draws.

nuisance_baselines.caption: Test AUROC for the hidden-state probe and every baseline fitted on the same training partition. The response-text bar is a leakage diagnostic, not a result: on a dataset whose response column encodes the label it will sit near 1.0 by construction. A probe that does not clearly exceed the nuisance-metadata bar is not evidence of a deception representation.
nuisance_baselines.uncertainty_method: point estimates; see the layerwise figure for seed spread

confound_subsets.caption: Probe AUROC inside each nuisance-matched subset, at the layer selected on validation. Matching equalises label counts within every stratum, so a drop relative to the unmatched set is the portion of apparent performance that the nuisance variable explained. Controls that could not run: equity_matched: requires usable ['hand_strength']; bet_size_matched: requires usable ['pot_size']

cross_scenario.reason: no cross-scenario transfer artifact exists. The generalization matrix (train on one context, evaluate on a held-out context, selecting only on source validation) is not implemented, so no figure can be drawn.
cross_scenario.name: cross_scenario

dose_response.caption: Paired change in forced_choice_positive_probability against steering strength on 500 held-out prompts (500 groups) at layer 31. The endpoint is the model's own output distribution, not the probe score. Decoding: deterministic single forward pass (no sampling) for the forced-choice endpoint. Error bars are paired grouped bootstrap 95% CIs.

intervention_controls.caption: Paired endpoint change for every condition at its strongest tested dose. Random matched-norm, orthogonal, shuffled-label, wrong-layer, wrong-token-position, and mismatched-prompt patching are controls: a steering effect is only interpretable if it clearly exceeds them.

intervention_quality.caption: Per-condition format adherence and positive-choice rate at the strongest tested dose. An intervention that moves the endpoint while collapsing format adherence has degraded the model rather than changed the target behaviour.
intervention_quality.uncertainty_method: point estimates over the held-out prompts

sae_diagnostics.caption: Diagnostics for the unsupervised SAE at layer 31, 32768 features (expansion 8.00x), topk activation. The SAE was trained without labels and frozen before these partitions were scored.
sae_diagnostics.uncertainty_method: none: single frozen dictionary, deterministic evaluation

sae_features.caption: Each point is one SAE feature selected by label separability on train+validation and then scored once on test. Features far below the diagonal were selection artifacts. No feature is assigned a semantic name here: correlation with the bluff label does not make a feature a deception feature.
sae_features.uncertainty_method: none: point estimates on the frozen test partition

not_run.cross_scenario: no cross-scenario transfer artifact exists. The generalization matrix (train on one context, evaluate on a held-out context, selecting only on source validation) is not implemented, so no figure can be drawn.
